hero.title: ERDENIS
hero.tagline: Reinforcement learning based attack and evasion decision-making for UAVs
hero.byline: Senior Design Project · Computer Engineering · TED University

project: ERDENIS develops a reinforcement learning based decision-making framework that lets unmanned aerial vehicles perform attack maneuvers when they hold an advantage and evasion maneuvers when they face a threat, while staying within the vehicle's physical capabilities. Agents are trained and tested in simulation, and the learned approach is compared with conventional methods.
goals: Build simulated air engagement scenarios for UAVs.
Train an RL agent that decides when to attack and when to evade.
Keep every maneuver within the vehicle's flight capabilities.
Compare the learning-based approach with conventional methods (attack success, evasion success, collision rate).
